coordinate_convention: Zero-based source-canvas pixels, x rightward/y downward. Waistband x endpoints are inclusive. All semantic row choices are explicitly game-authored after viewing every image; only file dimensions/hash and sampled alpha values are exact byte facts.

assets.view: front-on standing garment display; no seated compatibility implied

waistband_reference.basis: Reference row explicitly selected through the visible front waistband band, below its rolled top lip. Left/right points snapped to alpha>8 at this authored row; inclusive width. This is garment geometry, not a recovered body joint.

crotch_opening.basis: Visible first transparent central crotch opening beneath the fly; alpha<=8 confirms the opening in the visually inspected center neighborhood. It is not the target pelvis root or a body-crotch measurement.

hem_reference.basis: Explicit row near the visible low garment hems; one style-length reference, not a claim that both curved hems terminate at the same exact pixel.

visual_exclusions_or_uncertainty: Elastic waistband and ribbed ankle cuffs are style geometry; do not force the cuff to a dress-trouser opening.
White side stripes and relaxed leg ease are intentional.
Initial normalization does not establish body fit, waist/hip/crotch placement or human visual acceptance. Measure and inspect each exact body pairing.
